bugs.name: Saved category incorrectly triggers unsaved-changes confirmation on navigation
bugs.summary: After the category update succeeded and the Save control showed a clean state, leaving for All categories still opened a false “Leave without saving changes?” confirmation.
bugs.expected: After the category is successfully saved and no further edits are made, navigating to All categories proceeds without an unsaved-changes warning.
bugs.actual: The detail page showed a “Success — Category updated” confirmation and a disabled Save control, with the saved category details visible. Clicking All categories opened “Leave without saving changes?” and showed “Unsaved changes: general.” After choosing Ignore changes, the saved category remained in the categories list.
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture Saleor admin and open the Dashboard.
Open Catalog > Categories. The observed list URL was /categories/?asc=true&sort=name.
Create a fresh category named mo-saleor-01-catalog-category-unsaved-warning-7f3a with a description, then submit Create.

On the new category detail page, wait for the details to load and select Save. Observe the “Success — Category updated” confirmation and the disabled Save control with the saved values still displayed.

Select the All categories back control. Observe the “Leave without saving changes?” dialog and “Unsaved changes: general” indicator. After confirming the warning is stable, select Ignore changes; the saved category appears in the categories list.

bugs.name: Nested category search returns no matching child
bugs.summary: The Categories search does not find a visible child category by its exact name.
bugs.expected: Searching for Homewares should return the Homewares category shown under Accessories.
bugs.actual: Expanding Accessories shows Homewares as a child. Searching categories for Homewares changes the URL to ?query=Homewares and displays No categories found.
reproSteps: Sign in to Saleor and open Categories.
Expand Accessories and confirm its Homewares child is visible.
Enter Homewares in Search categories and press Enter.
Observe No categories found despite the visible child category.

bugs.name: Deleting a parent category does not warn that subcategories will be deleted
bugs.summary: The category deletion confirmation warns about products but omits cascading deletion of child categories.
bugs.expected: The confirmation should disclose that child categories will also be deleted.
bugs.actual: The product-unpinning warning is shown, and child categories disappear after confirmation without a subcategory-deletion warning.
reproSteps: Open the observed Categories URL /categories/ in the already-authenticated administrator session; no credentials were entered during this run.
Create a top-level category named `catgroup-parent-momentic-7j4n2`.
On its detail page, create the subcategory `catgroup-child-momentic-7j4n2`.
Return to the parent detail page and verify the Subcategories section lists `catgroup-child-momentic-7j4n2` as its one child; the page also shows no products assigned.
Open the parent’s settings menu and choose Delete category. Inspect the confirmation, which mentions unpinning assigned products but does not mention subcategories.
Confirm deletion. On the Categories list, search for `catgroup-child-momentic-7j4n2` and observe “No categories found.”
Refresh the Categories page and verify the same child search still shows “No categories found.”

bugs.name: Category bulk-delete confirmation reports zero selected categories
bugs.summary: Selecting two categories shows Delete categories (2) in the toolbar, but the bulk-delete confirmation says it will delete 0 categories.
bugs.expected: The bulk-delete confirmation should report the two selected categories, consistent with the toolbar and the selected rows.
bugs.actual: With Books and Default Category checked, the toolbar showed Delete categories (2). Opening the confirmation displayed Are you sure you want to delete 0 categories? while both rows remained selected. Choosing Back closed the dialog and retained both selections.
reproSteps: Open the supplied Saleor Dashboard fixture and sign in through the normal UI with the authorized fixture account. Dismiss the Saleor Pulse announcement if it blocks navigation.
Open Catalog > Categories at /categories/?asc=true&sort=name with no pre-existing dialog ids.
Select the checkbox for Default Category and wait for Delete categories (1). Select Books and wait for Delete categories (2); keep other categories unselected.
Click Delete categories (2). Observe Are you sure you want to delete 0 categories? while the two checked rows and toolbar count remain visible behind the dialog.
Choose Back and verify that both categories remain visible and selected. The incorrect confirmation count is reproducible without confirming deletion.
bugs.rootCause: CategoryList opens the bulk-delete modal with openModal("delete") without selected IDs, but passes params.ids.length ?? 0 as the dialog count. The toolbar and bulk-delete controller instead use selectedRowIds, so the confirmation receives zero despite a nonempty selection.
